title: Winrate
description: An advanced winrate system to track your pvp progress
body:
An advanced in-game tool to track your PvP performance over time.

What it does:

This mod lets you log your matches and keeps track of your stats, including:

Winrate
Wins and losses
Streaks
Match history
Performance per gamemode
Basic graphs showing progress over time

You can also enter an opponent name and fetch their MCTiers rank.

What it’s for

It’s made for players who play a lot of PvP and want a clear idea of how they’re doing.
Useful for improving, tracking progress, or just keeping stats.

How it works:
You manually log each game through a GUI
Data is saved locally in a JSON file
Stats are calculated instantly
MCTiers ranks are fetched through their public API (optional)

Everything is client-side.

How to use
Open the winrate screen
Click “Log Game”
Select win or loss
Pick a gamemode
(Optional) enter opponent name and fetch rank
Confirm

Then use the tabs to view overview, graphs, history, and stats per mode.

Notes
No server required
Works offline (except rank fetching)
Data is stored locally
